name: io.github.tonyyang0504/mercado_libre-marketplaces-mcp
description: Mercado Libre (marketplaces): me, get_product, update_price, list_sales. Every tool maps to a docume

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent by the seller's ADMIN account (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token. The state file is keyed by platform id, so it is shared with ecommerce_channels/mercado_libre: give each server its own PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR (or its own consent) so they never race on one single-use refresh token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_SELLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Mercado Libre user id of the seller (the `id` returned by GET /users/me); used as the seller filter of the order search.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADO_LIBRE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
